King George’s Medical University, U.P.
Department of Neurosurgery
Advertisement are invited for the following post
Applications are invited from Indian citizens for the following post under ICMR funded project
entitled "Creation of gold standard Medical Imaging dataset of dural based lesions treated with
Primary Gamma knife radiosurgery or Microsurgery for developing Artificial Intelligence tools’’
under Dr.Ankur Bajaj in the Department of Neurosurgery King George’s Medical University,
Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.
Duration of Project: 3 year (approx. 1 Year Remaining)

General Terms and Conditions:
● All salaries & experiences will be as per ICMR guidelines.
● Age as on the last date of submission of application should not be more than 30 years. Age
relaxation, if applicable, will be provided as per institutional/ICMR rules.
● Interested candidates should email their biodata/CV along with educational
qualifications and research experience in a single PDF file to
ankurbajaj@kgmcindia.edu.
The subject line should clearly mention:
“Application for Project Technical Support”
● Last date for application submission is 11 May 2026, and after that, applications
submitted thereafter will not be considered.
King George’s Medical University, U.P.
Department of Neurosurgery
 The interview will be conducted on 12 May 2026 at the Office of the Head of
Department, Department of Neurosurgery, 5th Floor, Shatabdi Phase II, King George’s
Medical University.
Reporting time: 2:00 PM
● No separate message or call will come for the interview. Any query can contact
9793047892 from 10 am to 4 pm, or can contact the Neurosurgery office, Shatabdi Phase
2, 5th Floor, KGMU.
● Submission of incomplete applications received after the closing date and time will not be
entertained.
● No TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the interview.
● Candidates must bring all original documents, certificates, mark sheets, ID proof, and
experience certificates at the time of the interview for verification.
● Candidates are advised to reach the interview venue on time. Candidates who are absent
or late on the date of the interview will not be entertained.
● The decision of the selection committee shall be final.
● This is an ICMR-funded post, so post is purely temporary/contractual, no claim for
permanent employment can be done, institute reserves right to cancel recruitment at any
time even without prior notice
